spans.s: स्तिप् vi. 1Ā (pres. स्तेपते) To ooze, to drip, to drop.
स्तेप् (II) vt. 10U (pres. स्तेपयति-ते) To send, to throw.
स्तेन् vt. 10U (pres. स्तेनयति-ते) (rather a denominative from स्तेन) To steal, M.iv.256.
स्तेन (I) m. A thief, a robber, ये स्तेनपतितक्लीबा ये च नास्तिकवृत्तयः M.iii.150.
स्तेन-निग्रह m. 1. the restraining or punishment of thieves; 2. suppression of theft.
स्तेय n. 1. Theft, robbery; 2. anything stolen or liable to be stolen; 3. any thing private.
स्तेयिन् m. 1. A thief, a robber; 2. a goldsmith.
